'''Business and economy'''
* The [[Voice of America]] reports that the [[Republic of Georgia]] is receiving an economic boost from the war in [[Ukraine]]. It is "expected to record a vigorous 10% growth in economic output for 2022 amid a consumption-led boom," due largely to the arrival of refugees from [[Russia]], seeking to avoid conscription or Putin's crackdown on dissent. [https://www.voanews.com/a/from-russia-with-cash-georgia-booms-as-russians-flee-putin-war/6821545.html (VOA News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed in a helicopter crash in [[Foggia]], [[Apulia]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.corriere.it/cronache/22_novembre_06/i-7-morti-sull-elicottero-precipitato-foggia-sloveni-medico-quelle-tragiche-fatalita-af4b737a-5d9d-11ed-9d14-8ce45c5ff6bb.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Quebec]], [[Canada]], registers its highest-ever temperature for November: {{cvt|25.3|C|F}} at [[Saint-Anicet]]. [https://www.meteomedia.com/ca/amp/nouvelles/article/record-de-temperature-de-tous-les-temps? (MétéoMédia)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Kostroma café fire]]
**At least 15 people are killed in a fire at a café in [[Kostroma]], [[Russia]]. Two hundred fifty others are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]]. The fire was started by a [[flare gun]] that discharged during an altercation. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/13-killed-250-evacuated-in-russian-cafe-fire-report-3492527 (NDTV)]
*Spanish police announce [[police raid|raids]] in [[Asturias]], [[Ciudad Real]], [[Toledo, Spain|Toledo]], and [[Valencia]] that netted the largest [[cannabis]] haul in history, "equivalent to approximately 1.1 million plants" and weighing more than 32 tonnes. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63527892 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Economy of Ghana]]
**More than 1,000 protesters march in [[Accra]] to demand the [[resignation]] of [[president of Ghana|president]] [[Nana Akufo-Addo]], amid a worsening economic crisis in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ghanaian-protesters-demand-president-step-down-over-economic-crisis-2022-11-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[MLS Cup 2022]]
**[[Los Angeles FC]] win their first [[MLS Cup]] title, defeating the [[Philadelphia Union]] 3–0 in a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] following a 3–3 draw at [[Banc of California Stadium]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]. [https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer/story/2022-11-05/lafc-defeats-philadelphia-penalty-kicks-mls-title (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[2022 World Series]]
**The [[Houston Astros]] defeat the [[Philadelphia Phillies]] in Game 6 of the [[2022 World Series]], winning the series 4 games to 2. They clinched their second World Series title, their first since [[2017 World Series|2017]]. At 73, [[Dusty Baker]] became the oldest in [[Major League Baseball]] history to win the World Series as a manager, while [[Jeremy Peña]] became only the third rookie to win [[World Series Most Valuable Player Award|MVP]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/11/05/sports/astros-phillies-world-series-score (''The New York Times'')]
